project.client: Dortech Direct (James, MD) via Andy Claridge, Tremco CPG
project.job: Standard garage Type 07 - Rendered two-storey single in Nudura ICF
project.model_title: DG-T07 Standard garage Type 07 - Rendered two-storey single in Nudura ICF - Quotation Q01

views.title: Raft slab
views.desc: Indicative 200 RC raft with a 600 x 450 thickened edge under the ICF, on DPM and 150 hardcore (engineer to design).

views.title: Nudura ICF walls
views.desc: Nudura 6in Standard on Nudura Bond, 3,639 x 7,499 outside - webs on the grid from both corners, NO stack joints; eaves walls 9 courses to the plate, gables raked to the roof; garage door with a one-course lintel, personnel door and windows on course lines. Every form as it would be laid.

views.title: First floor + stair
views.desc: 225 metal-web floor joists across the width on ICF ledgers, 22 P5 deck, quarter-turn timber stair to AD K: 5 treads along the rear wall, 3 kite winders, 6 up the west wall; 15 risers x 193 / 230 goings, 900 guarding round the well (cars still park inside).

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Loose rafters on a glulam ridge, gable ladders (indicative).

views.title: Roof membrane + battens
views.desc: Breathable roofing membrane and 25 x 50 treated battens.

views.title: Tiles, fascia, soffit + rainwater goods
views.desc: Marley Modern smooth grey concrete interlocking tiles, every tile drawn in broken bond, half-round dry ridge, dry verge, PVC-u fascia / soffit / 22 x 250 barge boards, half-round gutters + downpipes.

views.title: Windows + doors
views.desc: Anthracite (RAL 7016) window(s), composite personnel door, electric roller garage door (supplier).

views.title: Opening tapes
views.desc: Tremco CPG illbruck ME110 internal window membrane round every opening (garage door excluded).

views.title: Dryvit 500 render
views.desc: Dryvit 500 thin-coat render (Tremco CPG), 7.5 build-up, direct to the Nudura EPS, into the reveals to the frames.
